svg.aria-label: Animation: a settlement batch loads 8 cold storage pages when records sit at their home pages. After the admin rebalances them onto one packed page, the same batch loads 2 pages, or 1 with hints.
svg.title: Rebalancing the ERC-6909 ledger

g.text: 1 · Before: every record sits on its own home page, like a mapping entry
2 · The admin calls rebalance(): records move onto one packed page
3 · After: the same batch loads 2 pages, or 1 with hints
balance of token A or B
Each record is one storage word and a page is 128 words. Gas figures count page loads only.
